audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Deuteronomy / Devarim Decalogue retelling and Horeb mediation discourse, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for present-generation covenant, Ten Words, Sabbath liberation rationale, parental honor, prohibitions, coveting, fire/voice revelation, people's fear, Moses' mediation, and command to walk without turning.

verses.restored: Moses called to all Israel and said to them: Hear, Israel, statutes and judgments I speak in your ears today; learn them and keep to do them.

familiar.text: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.

modern.text: Then Moses summoned all Israel and said to them: Hear, O Israel, the statutes and ordinances that I declare in your hearing this day. Learn them and observe them carefully.

original.text: וַיִּקְרָ֣א מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם שְׁמַ֤ע יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת הַחֻקִּ֣ים וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י דֹּבֵ֥ר בְּאָזְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם וּלְמַדְתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔ם וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם לַעֲשֹׂתָֽם

verses.restored: YHWH our Divine cut a covenant with us at Horeb.

familiar.text: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

modern.text: The LORD our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.

original.text: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ כָּרַ֥ת עִמָּ֛נוּ בְּרִ֖ית בְּחֹרֵֽב

verses.restored: Not with our fathers alone did YHWH cut this covenant, but with us, we who are here today, all of us alive.

familiar.text: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.

modern.text: He did not make this covenant with our fathers, but with all of us who are alive here today.

original.text: לֹ֣א אֶת אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ כָּרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה אֶת הַבְּרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֑את כִּ֣י אִתָּ֗נוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ אֵ֥לֶּה פֹ֛ה הַיּ֖וֹם כֻּלָּ֥נוּ חַיִּֽים

verses.restored: Face to face YHWH spoke with you at mountain from midst of fire.

familiar.text: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,

modern.text: The LORD spoke with you face to face out of the fire on the mountain. The Ten Commandments (Exodus 20:1–17)

original.text: פָּנִ֣ים בְּפָנִ֗ים דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה עִמָּכֶ֛ם בָּהָ֖ר מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ

verses.restored: I stood between YHWH and you at that time to declare to you word of YHWH, for you feared because of fire and did not go up mountain, saying:

familiar.text: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to shew you the word of the LORD: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,

modern.text: At that time I was standing between the LORD and you to declare to you the word of the LORD, because you were afraid of the fire and would not go up the mountain. And He said:

original.text: אָ֠נֹכִי עֹמֵ֨ד בֵּין יְהוָ֤ה וּבֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא לְהַגִּ֥יד לָכֶ֖ם אֶת דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י יְרֵאתֶם֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָאֵ֔שׁ וְלֹֽא עֲלִיתֶ֥ם בָּהָ֖ר לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: I am YHWH your Divine, who brought you out from land of Egypt, from house of slaves.

familiar.text: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

modern.text: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

original.text: אָֽנֹכִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֧ר הוֹצֵאתִ֛יךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים

verses.restored: You shall have no other gods before my face.

familiar.text: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.

modern.text: You shall have no other gods before Me.

original.text: לֹא יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים עַל פָּנָֽיַ

verses.restored: You shall not make for yourself carved image, any likeness of what is in heavens above or earth beneath or waters under earth.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:

modern.text: You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.

original.text: לֹֽ֣א תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְךָ֥ פֶ֨סֶל֙ כָּל תְּמוּנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ מִמַּ֔עַל וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּאָ֖רֶץ מִתָּ֑חַת וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּמַּ֖יִם מִתַּ֥חַת לָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: You shall not bow to them or serve them, for I YHWH your Divine am a jealous Divine, visiting iniquity of fathers upon children to third and fourth of those hating me,

familiar.text: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,

modern.text: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on their children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,

original.text: לֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֣א תָעָבְדֵ֑ם כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֞י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ אֵ֣ל קַנָּ֔א פֹּ֠קֵד עֲוֺ֨ן אָב֧וֹת עַל בָּנִ֛ים וְעַל שִׁלֵּשִׁ֥ים וְעַל רִבֵּעִ֖ים לְשֹׂנְאָֽי

verses.restored: but doing covenant loyalty to thousands of those loving me and keeping my commands.

familiar.text: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.

modern.text: but showing loving devotion to a thousand generations of those who love Me and keep My commandments.

original.text: וְעֹ֥שֶׂה חֶ֖סֶד לַֽאֲלָפִ֑ים לְאֹהֲבַ֖י וּלְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י מצותו

verses.restored: You shall not lift up name of YHWH your Divine for emptiness, for YHWH will not hold guiltless one who lifts his name for emptiness.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

modern.text: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain.

original.text: לֹ֥א תִשָּׂ֛א אֶת שֵֽׁם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לַשָּׁ֑וְא כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יְנַקֶּה֙ יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר יִשָּׂ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖וֹ לַשָּֽׁוְא

verses.restored: Keep Sabbath day to sanctify it, as YHWH your Divine commanded you.

familiar.text: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.

modern.text: Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy, as the LORD your God has commanded you.

original.text: שָׁמ֛וֹר אֶת י֥וֹם הַשַׁבָּ֖ת לְקַדְּשׁ֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Six days you shall serve and do all your work,

familiar.text: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:

modern.text: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

original.text: שֵׁ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ תַּֽעֲבֹ֔ד וְעָשִׂ֖יתָ כָּל מְלַאכְתֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: but seventh day is Sabbath to YHWH your Divine. You shall do no work—you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, your ox, your donkey, any beast, or your sojourner within your gates—so your male servant and female servant may rest like you.

familiar.text: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.

modern.text: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, on which you must not do any work—neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant, nor your ox or donkey or any of your livestock, nor the foreigner within your gates, so that your manservant and maidservant may rest as you do.

original.text: וְי֨וֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י שַׁבָּ֖ת לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לֹ֣א תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה כָל מְלָאכָ֡ה אַתָּ֣ה וּבִנְךָֽ וּבִתֶּ֣ךָ וְעַבְדְּךָֽ וַ֠אֲמָתֶךָ וְשׁוֹרְךָ֨ וַחֲמֹֽרְךָ֜ וְכָל בְּהֶמְתֶּ֗ךָ וְגֵֽרְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ לְמַ֗עַן יָנ֛וּחַ עַבְדְּךָ֥ וַאֲמָתְךָ֖ כָּמֽוֹךָ

verses.restored: Remember you were a slave in land of Egypt, and YHWH your Divine brought you out from there with strong hand and outstretched arm; therefore YHWH your Divine commanded you to make Sabbath day.

familiar.text: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.

modern.text: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD your God brought you out of there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. That is why the LORD your God has commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.

original.text: וְזָכַרְתָּ֗ כִּ֣י עֶ֤בֶד הָיִ֨יתָ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיֹּצִ֨אֲךָ֜ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ מִשָּׁ֔ם בְּיָ֥ד חֲזָקָ֖ה וּבִזְרֹ֣עַ נְטוּיָ֑ה עַל כֵּ֗ן צִוְּךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת אֶת י֥וֹם הַשַׁבָּֽת

verses.restored: Honor your father and your mother, as YHWH your Divine commanded you, so your days may lengthen and it may be well with you upon ground YHWH your Divine is giving you.

familiar.text: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

modern.text: Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God has commanded you, so that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.

original.text: כַּבֵּ֤ד אֶת אָבִ֨יךָ֙ וְאֶת אִמֶּ֔ךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֣עַן יַאֲרִיכֻ֣ן יָמֶ֗יךָ וּלְמַ֨עַן֙ יִ֣יטַב לָ֔ךְ עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ

verses.restored: You shall not murder.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not kill.

modern.text: You shall not murder.

original.text: לֹ֖א תִּרְצָֽח

verses.restored: You shall not commit adultery.

familiar.text: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.

modern.text: You shall not commit adultery.

original.text: וְלֹ֖א תִּנְאָֽף

verses.restored: You shall not steal.

familiar.text: Neither shalt thou steal.

modern.text: You shall not steal.

original.text: וְלֹ֖א תִּגְנֹֽב

verses.restored: You shall not answer against your neighbor as false witness.

familiar.text: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.

modern.text: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.

original.text: וְלֹֽא תַעֲנֶ֥ה בְרֵֽעֲךָ֖ עֵ֥ד שָֽׁוְא

verses.restored: You shall not covet your neighbor's wife, and you shall not desire your neighbor's house, field, male servant, female servant, ox, donkey, or anything belonging to your neighbor.

familiar.text: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour’s wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour’s house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour’s.

modern.text: You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. You shall not covet your neighbor’s house or field, or his manservant or maidservant, or his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.” Moses Intercedes for the People (Exodus 20:18–21; Hebrews 12:18–29)

original.text: וְלֹ֥א תַחְמֹ֖ד אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֶ֑ךָ וְלֹ֨א תִתְאַוֶּ֜ה בֵּ֣ית רֵעֶ֗ךָ שָׂדֵ֜הוּ וְעַבְדּ֤וֹ וַאֲמָתוֹ֙ שׁוֹר֣וֹ וַחֲמֹר֔וֹ וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְרֵעֶֽךָ

verses.restored: These words YHWH spoke to all your assembly at mountain from midst of fire, cloud, and thick gloom, with a great voice, and he added no more; he wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me.

familiar.text: These words the LORD spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.

modern.text: The LORD spoke these commandments in a loud voice to your whole assembly out of the fire, the cloud, and the deep darkness on the mountain; He added nothing more. And He wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me.

original.text: אֶֽת הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֡לֶּה דִּבֶּר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶל כָּל קְהַלְכֶ֜ם בָּהָ֗ר מִתּ֤וֹךְ הָאֵשׁ֙ הֶֽעָנָ֣ן וְהָֽעֲרָפֶ֔ל ק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל וְלֹ֣א יָסָ֑ף וַֽיִּכְתְּבֵ֗ם עַל שְׁנֵי֙ לֻחֹ֣ת אֲבָנִ֔ים וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם אֵלָֽי

verses.restored: When you heard voice from midst of darkness while mountain burned with fire, you came near to me, all heads of your tribes and elders.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

modern.text: And when you heard the voice out of the darkness while the mountain was blazing with fire, all the heads of your tribes and your elders approached me,

original.text: וַיְהִ֗י כְּשָׁמְעֲכֶ֤ם אֶת הַקּוֹל֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַחֹ֔שֶׁךְ וְהָהָ֖ר בֹּעֵ֣ר בָּאֵ֑שׁ וַתִּקְרְב֣וּן אֵלַ֔י כָּל רָאשֵׁ֥י שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֖ם וְזִקְנֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: You said, Look, YHWH our Divine has shown us his glory and greatness, and his voice we heard from midst of fire. This day we saw that Divine speaks with human and he lives.

familiar.text: And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.

modern.text: and you said, “Behold, the LORD our God has shown us His glory and greatness, and we have heard His voice out of the fire. Today we have seen that a man can live even if God speaks with him.

original.text: וַתֹּאמְר֗וּ הֵ֣ן הֶרְאָ֜נוּ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֨ינוּ֙ אֶת כְּבֹד֣וֹ וְאֶת גָּדְל֔וֹ וְאֶת קֹל֥וֹ שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הָאֵ֑שׁ הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ רָאִ֔ינוּ כִּֽי יְדַבֵּ֧ר אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת הָֽאָדָ֖ם וָחָֽי

verses.restored: Now why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we continue to hear voice of YHWH our Divine anymore, we shall die.

familiar.text: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.

modern.text: But now, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us, and we will die, if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any longer.

original.text: וְעַתָּה֙ לָ֣מָּה נָמ֔וּת כִּ֣י תֹֽאכְלֵ֔נוּ הָאֵ֥שׁ הַגְּדֹלָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את אִם יֹסְפִ֣ים אֲנַ֗חְנוּ לִ֠שְׁמֹעַ אֶת ק֨וֹל יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ ע֖וֹד וָמָֽתְנוּ

verses.restored: For who of all flesh has heard voice of living Divine speaking from midst of fire as we have and lived?

familiar.text: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?

modern.text: For who of all flesh has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the fire, as we have, and survived?

original.text: כִּ֣י מִ֣י כָל בָּשָׂ֡ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֣ע קוֹל֩ אֱלֹהִ֨ים חַיִּ֜ים מְדַבֵּ֧ר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵ֛שׁ כָּמֹ֖נוּ וַיֶּֽחִי

verses.restored: You draw near and hear all YHWH our Divine says, and you shall speak to us all YHWH our Divine speaks to you; we will hear and do.

familiar.text: Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.

modern.text: Go near and listen to all that the LORD our God says. Then you can tell us everything the LORD our God tells you; we will listen and obey.”

original.text: קְרַ֤ב אַתָּה֙ וּֽשֲׁמָ֔ע אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹאמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְאַ֣תְּ תְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֗ינוּ אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְדַבֵּ֜ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְשָׁמַ֥עְנוּ וְעָשִֽׂינוּ

verses.restored: YHWH heard voice of your words when you spoke to me, and YHWH said to me, I have heard voice of words of this people that they spoke to you; they have done well in all they spoke.

familiar.text: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.

modern.text: And the LORD heard the words you spoke to me, and He said to me, “I have heard the words that these people have spoken to you. They have done well in all that they have spoken.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ אֶת ק֣וֹל דִּבְרֵיכֶ֔ם בְּדַבֶּרְכֶ֖ם אֵלָ֑י וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י שָׁ֠מַעְתִּי אֶת ק֨וֹל דִּבְרֵ֜י הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבְּר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ הֵיטִ֖יבוּ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽרוּ

verses.restored: Who would give that this heart of theirs were in them to fear/revere me and keep all my commands all days, so it might be well with them and their children forever?

familiar.text: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!

modern.text: If only they had such a heart to fear Me and keep all My commandments always, so that it might be well with them and with their children forever.

original.text: מִֽי יִתֵּ֡ן וְהָיָה֩ לְבָבָ֨ם זֶ֜ה לָהֶ֗ם לְיִרְאָ֥ה אֹתִ֛י וְלִשְׁמֹ֥ר אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺתַ֖י כָּל הַיָּמִ֑ים לְמַ֨עַן יִיטַ֥ב לָהֶ֛ם וְלִבְנֵיהֶ֖ם לְעֹלָֽם

verses.restored: Go say to them, Return to your tents.

familiar.text: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.

modern.text: Go and tell them: ‘Return to your tents.’

original.text: לֵ֖ךְ אֱמֹ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם שׁ֥וּבוּ לָכֶ֖ם לְאָהֳלֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: But you stand here with me, and I will speak to you all command, statutes, and judgments you shall teach them, that they may do them in land I give them to possess.

familiar.text: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.

modern.text: But you stand here with Me, that I may speak to you all the commandments and statutes and ordinances you are to teach them to follow in the land that I am giving them to possess.”

original.text: וְאַתָּ֗ה פֹּה֮ עֲמֹ֣ד עִמָּדִי֒ וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה אֵלֶ֗יךָ אֵ֧ת כָּל הַמִּצְוָ֛ה וְהַחֻקִּ֥ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תְּלַמְּדֵ֑ם וְעָשׂ֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ

verses.restored: You shall keep to do as YHWH your Divine commanded you; you shall not turn aside right or left.

familiar.text: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

modern.text: So be careful to do as the LORD your God has commanded you; you are not to turn aside to the right or to the left.

original.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם אֶתְכֶ֑ם לֹ֥א תָסֻ֖רוּ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאל

verses.restored: In all way YHWH your Divine commanded you, you shall walk, so you may live and it may be well with you and you may lengthen days in land you shall possess.

familiar.text: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.

modern.text: You must walk in all the ways that the LORD your God has commanded you, so that you may live and prosper and prolong your days in the land that you will possess.

original.text: בְּכָל הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֜ה יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם אֶתְכֶ֖ם תֵּלֵ֑כוּ לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽחְיוּן֙ וְט֣וֹב לָכֶ֔ם וְהַאֲרַכְתֶּ֣ם יָמִ֔ים בָּאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּֽירָשֽׁוּן

translation_notes: Deuteronomy presents the Horeb covenant as directly present to the living generation, making memory participatory rather than merely ancestral.
The Sabbath rationale centers liberation: servants, animals, and sojourners rest because Israel remembers slavery.
Visiting ancestral iniquity language must not be used to blame children for abuse, illness, disability, or family trauma; the text contrasts limited consequence with expansive covenant loyalty.
Parental honor never requires submission to abuse or concealment of harm.
The coveting list reflects an ancient household economy in which wife and servants appear within possessions; this structure must not define modern personhood.
The people's request for mediation is affirmed, while Moses remains a teacher rather than replacement for direct covenant responsibility.
safety_note: Do not use Deuteronomy 5 to justify inherited guilt, abusive parental control, ownership of spouses or servants, religious coercion, or antisemitic claims that Torah is merely oppressive law. Center liberation, universal rest within the household, truth, non-murder, and covenant responsibility.
